nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in the constructor; gates delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances mutated in transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of spenders' allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping counting per-address sale participations; incremented with unchecked arithmetic.
Private whitelist mapping consulted by ensure to bypass sale restrictions.
Private minimum sale amount configuration used by condition.
Private maximum sale amount configuration used by condition.
Private per-address sale count limit configuration used by condition.
Address whitelisted in ensure; settable only by the owner through setTradeAddress.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted in ensure.
Public total supply of the UniswapExchange token set in the constructor.
ERC20 private balance mapping mutated by _transfer.
ERC20 private nested allowance mapping.
ERC20 private total supply variable.
Public payable transfer entry point that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from.
Internal view whitelist gate: allows owner, UNI, tradeAddress, computed pair or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition to pass.
Core public payable transfer logic; mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic after only a whitelist check.
Public payable approval writer keyed by msg.sender.
Internal view sale-limit check comparing _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale against _value.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using unchecked multiplications and powers.
Owner-only loop distributing tokens; total is computed with unchecked multiplication.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure CREATE2 pair address computation using the Uniswap factory init code hash.
Payable constructor that sets owner, totalSupply, balances and an unlimited allowance to the router.
Internal ERC20 transfer using SafeMath for balance updates.
Internal view helper returning msg.sender for ERC20 functions.
Private helper performing a low-level call to a token contract and decoding the optional boolean result.
a.delegatecall(b) executes arbitrary user supplied code in the contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed with raw unchecked subtraction (Solidity 0.5 has no built-in overflow checks).
uint total = _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked multiplication.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ performed with unchecked arithmetic.
address(token).call(data) low-level external call that can re-enter or return unexpected data.
msg.sender as the caller of transfer/approve/transferFrom, controlling allowance and identity.
msg.sender compared against owner in init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
msg.sender compared against owner in delegate, gating the arbitrary delegatecall.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Target contract address of the delegatecall.
Calldata bytes forwarded to the delegatecall.
Sale count limit configuration argument of init.
Minimum sale amount argument of init.
Maximum sale amount argument of init.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount argument of batchSend.
New trade address argument of setTradeAddress.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address used in the ensure whitelist comparison.
Locally computed total = _value * _tos.length inside batchSend.
Source address argument of ensure.
Amount argument of ensure.
Address argument of condition, indexed into _onSaleNum.
Amount argument of condition compared to _minSale/_maxSale.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the allowance spender check and identity inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], so caller identity controls the allowance entry.
msg.sender is returned by the _msgSender helper.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the source address.
approve uses _msgSender() as allowance owner.
init is restricted by the msg.sender == owner check.
batchSend is restricted by the msg.sender == owner check.
setTradeAddress is restricted by the msg.sender == owner check.
delegate is restricted only by the msg.sender == owner check.
The delegatecall is only reachable when msg.sender equals owner.
owner is one of the whitelisted addresses that short-circuits ensure.
owner requirement gates execution of delegate.
owner requirement gates execution of init.
owner requirement gates execution of batchSend.
owner requirement gates execution of setTradeAddress.
canSale[_from] whitelist flag allows bypassing condition in ensure.
tradeAddress is compared against _from inside ensure.
The UNI router constant is compared against _from inside ensure.
pairFor returns the computed _UNI pair address.
ensure invokes pairFor to compute the whitelisted pair address.
The locally computed _UNI is compared against _from in ensure.
ensure requires condition(_from,_value) to succeed for non-whitelisted callers.
_minSale is compared against _value in condition.
_maxSale is compared against _value in condition.
_saleNum gates the per-address limit in condition.
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum in condition.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) to return true.
_from is used for allowance, balance and _onSaleNum indexing in transferFrom.
_to receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value drives allowance and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_from is passed from transferFrom into ensure.
_value is passed from transferFrom into ensure.
ensure reads its _from parameter for whitelist checks.
ensure forwards its _value parameter to condition.
ensure passes _from into condition.
ensure passes _value into condition.
condition indexes _onSaleNum with its _from parameter.
condition compares its _value parameter against _minSale and _maxSale.
transferFrom performs an unchecked subtraction of the sender balance.
transferFrom performs an unchecked increment of _onSaleNum.
transferFrom directly mutates balanceOf for _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom writes _onSaleNum[_from] with unchecked increment.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b is the delegatecall calldata.
User supplied address a is used as the delegatecall destination.
User supplied bytes b are executed as delegatecall code.
delegate executes arbitrary external code in the contract context, guarded only by the owner check.
saleNum argument is stored in _saleNum.
token argument is scaled and stored in _minSale.
maxToken argument is scaled and stored in _maxSale.
init computes _minSale with unchecked multiplication and exponentiation.
init computes _maxSale with unchecked multiplication and exponentiation.
init assigns the sale count limit.
_tos supplies the recipients iterated in batchSend.
_value is the per-recipient amount credited in batchSend.
batchSend computes total as _value multiplied by the unvalidated array length.
The locally computed total derives from an unchecked multiplication.
batchSend executes the unchecked multiplication computing total.
batchSend mutates balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient.
addr argument is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress stores the new value into tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns msg.sender to owner.
Constructor mints the entire supply to the deployer balance.
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the router address.
ERC20 _transfer updates _balances for sender and recipient.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call to the token contract before results are verified.
The delegatecall can overwrite the owner storage slot in the caller context.
Unchecked increment writes the _onSaleNum mapping.

normalization_plan.reason: The _from parameter only exists to feed transferFrom's allowance, balance and sale-count logic.
The _to parameter only exists as the credit target inside transferFrom.
The _value parameter is a plain argument consumed solely by transferFrom arithmetic.
Parameter a is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is the calldata bytes supplied directly to the delegatecall operation.
saleNum is only stored into _saleNum during init.
token is only consumed when computing _minSale in init.
maxToken is only consumed when computing _maxSale in init.
The recipient array is only iterated inside batchSend.
The per-recipient amount is only consumed by batchSend's loop.
addr is only assigned to the tradeAddress state variable.
The computed pair address is a temporary value used only inside ensure's whitelist check.
total exists purely as the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
The _from parameter of ensure is only used for the whitelist comparison.
The _value parameter of ensure is only forwarded to condition.
The _from parameter of condition is only used to index _onSaleNum.
The _value parameter of condition is only compared against the sale limits.
